title: MAIN THEME EPISODE 15: DISSOCIATIVE RECOMBINATION
lines: 01 MAIN THEME EPISODE 15: DISSOCIATIVE RECOMBINATION
OPEN TIME: September 16, 2025, 10:00 (UTC-7)
EXTREME MODE OPEN TIME: September 23, 2025, 16:00 (UTC-7)
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 3-8

DETAILS: During the event, EP15 Dissociative Recombination will be open, and players can earn the ['Courage' Badge] for a limited time by completing stages in the Dissociative Recombination. (The badge can be used to redeem items in Closure's Backup.)
Note:
◆ After September 30, 2025, 04:00 (UTC-7), the limited-time drop of Dissociative Recombination stages will end and be replaced by a permanent drop.
◆ After the EP15 Dissociative Recombination unlocks, players can earn Simulation Points from Strategic Simulation for an extra rewards (Originite Prime, Elite Materials) and unlock Extreme Mode.
[ OFF-BOARD CHECKLIST]
DETAILS: During the event, players can complete [Off-board Checklist] missions by clearing event stages to gain rewards.
REWARDS: 0011 Tempest Series - Candy Strike for Odda, Plaque - Luxury, Elite Materials, LMD, etc.

From September 16, 2025, 10:00 to September 30, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7), players can obtain 'Courage' Badge by completing this missions in [Off-board Checklist]. (Unclaimed 'Courage' Badge from limited-time missions completed before September 30, 03:59 can still be claimed until October 7, 03:59 (UTC-7).)
[CLOSURE'S BACKUP]
DURATION: September 16, 2025, 10:00 - October 7, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain 'Courage' Badge by clearing event stages and completing [Off-board Checklist]. 'Courage' Badge can be used to redeem items from [Closure's Backup].

REWARDS: Emergency Sanity Sampler, Rhodes Island Supply Crate (contains Emergency Sanity Sampler*1 and Rhodes Island Supplies VIII*1), 'As the Last Breath Lingers' Furniture (Pieces), 0011 Tempest Series - Glen Sonata - Asbestos, Interface Theme [Misty City], Module Materials, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, etc.
Note:
Players who have previously obtained the outfit [0011 Tempest Series - Glen Sonata - Asbestos] and the Interface Theme [Misty City] cannot redeem them again from the [Closure's Backup].
02 LIMITED-TIME HEADHUNTING OPEN – COMMAND: RECONSTRUCTION
DURATION: September 16, 2025, 10:00 - September 30, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, the Limited-time Headhunting, [Command: Reconstruction], opens and the following Operators will appear at a higher rate:
★★★★★: Alanna / Cement
★★★★: Windscoot
Note:

This is a [Standard Headhunting]. If you make 150 headhunting attempts without receiving the current rate-up 6-star Operator, the next 6-star operator received is guaranteed to be the current rate-up 6-star Operator.
03 NEW OPERATORS NOW AVAILABLE
The following Operators will be added to the game:
★★★★★: Alanna
★★★★: Windscoot
Note:
◆ Mon3tr, Alanna and Windscoot will become available in other [Standard Headhuntings] after September 30, 2025, 04:00 (UTC-7).
◆ Mon3tr, Alanna and Windscoot will gain more trust from all sanity-consuming stages, except Annihilation and Intermezzi, from September 16, 2025, 10:00 to September 30, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7).
04 ENCOURAGE EVENT OPEN
DURATION: September 16, 2025, 10:00 - September 30, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, if you fail a mission in any combat environment of Dissociative Recombination that you have not yet cleared, the full Sanity cost will be refunded.

07 NEW FURNITURE SET – 'As the Last Breath Lingers'
DETAILS: Brand new set of themed Furniture, 'As the Last Breath Lingers' will be available during the event.
HOW TO OBTAIN:
◆ Dissociative Recombination event rewards and redeemable (pieces)
◆ Limited-time sale at the Store (pieces)
DURATION: September 16, 2025, 10:00 - September 30, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
08 LIMITED-TIME PACKS AVAILABLE
DETAILS: During the event, the following packs will be available at the Store for a limited time.

[Command: Reconstruction Headhunting Bundle]
DURATION: September 16, 2025, 10:00 - September 29, 2025, 23:59 (UTC-7)

Note:

◆ The [Command: Reconstruction Headhunting Permit] can only be used for a single headhunting the Limited-time Headhunting, [Command: Reconstruction], while the [Command: Reconstruction Ten-roll Headhunting Permit] can only be used for a Ten-roll headhunting in the [Command: Reconstruction].
◆ Both the [Command: Reconstruction Headhunting Permit] and [Command: Reconstruction Ten-roll Headhunting Permit] will expire on September 30, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7).
